font.wordmark: Bricolage Grotesque 800 — the VIPTV wordmark only
font.titles: Title logos (images) instead of typed titles wherever art provides one

focus.tvCard: inner ring: box-shadow inset 0 0 0 4px #FFFFFF, inset 0 0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35) — nothing scales
focus.tvButton: focused = solid white fill, others translucent

hero.art: framed 16:9 card, never wider than the source (~774px), never upscaled
hero.ambient: blurred copy behind: filter: blur(60px) saturate(1.3); opacity: 0.45; transform: scale(1.25);
hero.wide: ≥ ~1800px of content: third column (Featured queue on Home, Details on title pages)

breakpoints.desktopNav: collapsed icon rail ≥ 641px, menu button below — never an expanded sidebar
